notes: Both Rustam and Diana on iPhone: mandatory Face ID with verified PIN fallback.
Per-account PWA unlock durations: immediately, 10 min, 1 hour (default), 5 hours.
Timed unlock persists through PWA relaunch; immediate always requires recheck on relaunch and return from background.
Changing the selected interval survives restart and immediate invalidates the previous long session.
Hide redundant PWA installation row in already installed PWA; no deployment before approval.
versionPolicy: Крупное обновление: следующий целый номер. Мелкое обновление: следующий десятичный номер. Один пакет изменений = один production deploy.
